game.title: DmC: Devil May Cry
game.blurb: Hack-and-slash action game that reboots the Devil May Cry series, from Ninja Theory, released 2013-01-15. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Dante's missions, from shaking off your pursuer to the Tyrant, Phineas, the Vault and the final showdown with Mundus.

chapters.title: Weapons, Abilities and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Picking up Arbiter, Osiris, Eryx, Aquila, Revenant and Kablooey, Angel Boost and Devil Trigger, and spending Red Orbs on upgrades.

chapters.title: Keys, Secret Doors, Lost Souls and Secret Missions
chapters.summary: Finding every Key and Secret Door, freeing the Lost Souls, the Secret Missions and 100% completion of every mission.

chapters.title: Mission Challenges
chapters.summary: No-damage and against-the-clock runs, the Furnace of Souls, and the special goals on Missions 1, 6 and 16.

chapters.title: Harder Difficulties
chapters.summary: Finishing every mission on Son of Sparda, Dante Must Die, Heaven or Hell, Hell and Hell, and Nephilim with an SSS rank.

chapters.title: Vergil's Downfall
chapters.summary: The Vergil's Downfall campaign, its upgrades, 100% completion and its own difficulty runs.

chapters.title: Combat and Style
chapters.summary: Demon kill counts, weapon-only kills, SSS style ranks, Style Bonuses and special enemies such as Wisps and Imprisoners.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "DmC: Devil May Cry" or "DmC Devil May Cry". devilmaycry.fandom.com answers the API, with about 241 linked pages, including "Dante (DmC)", "Arbiter", "Aquila" and "Bloody Palace"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "ValveTestApp220440" (a placeholder name); the store list confirms app 220440 as "DmC: Devil May Cry". The Steam app list has no separate Definitive Edition app; RAWG lists "DmC: Devil May Cry: Definitive Edition" (2015) as its own entry, and the base entry "dmc" was used. None of the 58 Steam achievements is hidden. Achievements 51 to 58 are for "Vergil's downfall", which RAWG also lists as its own entry ("DmC: Devil May Cry - Vergil's Downfall"), so they have their own chapter. RAWG's description names the developer as "Team Ninja", but its developer field says Ninja Theory; the developer field was used. RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours.
